{
  "decision-kiln-pair-recovery-allocation": "SELECT e.cycle_code AS east_cycle, w.cycle_code AS west_cycle, e.tile_gain + w.tile_gain AS recovered_tiles, e.labor_min + w.labor_min AS tech_min, e.glaze_g + w.glaze_g AS glaze_g
FROM kiln_cycle AS e CROSS JOIN kiln_cycle AS w CROSS JOIN shift_limits AS s
WHERE e.kiln_code = 'E' AND w.kiln_code = 'W'
  AND e.labor_min + w.labor_min <= s.minute_cap
  AND e.glaze_g + w.glaze_g <= s.gram_cap
ORDER BY recovered_tiles DESC, tech_min ASC, glaze_g ASC, east_cycle COLLATE BINARY ASC, west_cycle COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-kiln-shift-firing-plan": "WITH options AS (
  SELECT *, pieces * (price_cents - unit_cost_cents) - setup_cents AS contribution
  FROM firing_menu
)
SELECT c.plan_code AS cup_plan, t.plan_code AS tile_plan, c.kiln_minutes + t.kiln_minutes AS kiln_minutes, c.clay_kg + t.clay_kg AS clay_kg, c.contribution + t.contribution AS contribution_cents, b.source_id AS source_id
FROM options AS c CROSS JOIN options AS t CROSS JOIN shift_brief AS b
WHERE c.line_code = 'cups' AND t.line_code = 'tiles'
  AND c.kiln_minutes + t.kiln_minutes <= b.minute_cap
  AND c.clay_kg + t.clay_kg <= b.clay_cap
ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC, kiln_minutes ASC, cup_plan COLLATE BINARY ASC, tile_plan COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-kiln-simpson-reversal": "WITH paired AS (
  SELECT a.accepted AS a_tiles, a.hours AS a_hours, b.accepted AS b_tiles, b.hours AS b_hours
  FROM kiln_runs AS a JOIN kiln_runs AS b ON a.tile_size = b.tile_size
  WHERE a.method = 'A' AND b.method = 'B'
), pooled AS (
  SELECT SUM(a_tiles) AS atot, SUM(a_hours) AS ah, SUM(b_tiles) AS btot, SUM(b_hours) AS bh,
         MIN(a_tiles * b_hours > b_tiles * a_hours) AS a_wins_both,
         MIN(b_tiles * a_hours > a_tiles * b_hours) AS b_wins_both
  FROM paired
)
SELECT ROUND(1.0 * atot / ah, 3) AS a_tiles_per_hour, ROUND(1.0 * btot / bh, 3) AS b_tiles_per_hour,
       CASE WHEN (a_wins_both AND atot * bh < btot * ah) OR (b_wins_both AND btot * ah < atot * bh) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reversal
FROM pooled",
  "decision-kit-cost-with-slot-substitutes": "WITH RECURSIVE ranked AS (
  SELECT parent, child, qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY parent, slot ORDER BY priority ASC, child COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS choice
  FROM bom
), paths(part, units) AS (
  SELECT 'kit', 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.child, p.units * r.qty
  FROM paths AS p JOIN ranked AS r ON r.parent = p.part AND r.choice = 1
)
SELECT 'kit' AS root_part, SUM(p.units * pr.cents) AS cost_cents
FROM paths AS p JOIN prices AS pr ON pr.part = p.part
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bom AS b WHERE b.parent = p.part)"
}
